item.title: Mochi Press 1.1.1
item.description:
• Fixed: Mochi Press could freeze when extracting large archives (RAR, 7z, ISO and more), after which Extract did nothing until the app was force-quit.
  • Extract from the Finder menu, Quick Actions and the Services menu now shows the progress panel.
  • Mochi Press can now be set as the default app for RAR files, as well as .cab, .tgz, .tbz2, .xz and .txz.
